product.name: Altair Satellite Constellation
product.description: A constellation of AI-enabled satellites designed for real-time sensing, compute, and connectivity.

product.name: Physical Mission Platforms
product.description: Off-the-shelf satellite platforms for rapid deployment of satellite constellations and physical space missions.

product.name: Virtual Mission Framework
product.description: A software framework allowing customers to develop and deploy applications on Orbitworks’ spacecraft for sensing and compute.

product.name: On Demand Mission Services
product.description: Access to sensing, compute, and connectivity resources from Orbitworks’ on-orbit satellite fleet on demand.

product.name: Assembly, Integration & Test (AIT) Facility
product.description: A dedicated facility in Abu Dhabi for satellite assembly, integration, testing, and payload customization.
